visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young women stand in front of a large mural at an airport. The woman in the center wears a beige long-sleeved crop top and olive cargo pants. The woman on the left wears a white t-shirt and black shorts, and the woman on the right wears a black hoodie and black trousers. They are surrounded by large, colorful suitcases. The mural behind them features text about Seoul and a large circular graphic with fireworks and a cityscape. (2) The scene cuts to an outdoor park with vibrant yellow ginkgo trees. The women are posing; the central woman in a yellow off-the-shoulder dress holds a smartphone toward the camera. They are smiling and making peace signs. (3) They appear in front of a white, castle-like building with blue spires. They are now wearing school-style uniforms with gray blazers and pleated skirts. The central woman holds the phone, showing a photo of the group. (4) A close-up shot focuses on the smartphone screen, which displays a photo of the three women in their school uniforms. (5) Back in the park with yellow leaves, the women have changed outfits again. The central woman wears a beige top and black mini-skirt. They pose with a coffee cup and wave at the camera. (6) Another transition to the park setting where the women wear heavier autumn clothing. The central woman is in a brown faux-fur coat and leopard-print skirt. (7) The final scene takes place inside a modern terminal. A large glass pane in the background has the word 'Departures' printed on it. The women strike a final pose together, smiling brightly.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: Taking Memories of Seoul with You. 서울의 추억을 담아 갑니다. 서울 하늘길의 시작, 김포국제공항. (8) [Subtitle]: Departures.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: Three young women in their early 20s. One often wears a beige crop top or yellow dress; another wears black shorts or school uniforms; the third often wears a black hoodie or gray sweaters. Their style shifts between casual, school-girl chic, and autumn fashion.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video features multiple locations including the Gimpo International Airport terminal with commemorative murals, an outdoor park dense with yellow ginkgo trees during autumn, and the entrance of a theme park resembling a castle.

The tempo is fast, and the beat is driving with heavy synthesized bass. (2) A sharp 'pop' sound effect occurs, coinciding with a visual transition. The music continues its upbeat rhythmic pattern without losing momentum. (3) The vocal line continues into a melodic refrain. Another sharp digital transient effect marks the next edit. (4) The music reaches a high-energy peak with layered synthesizers. The 'pop' SFX is heard repeatedly, synchronized with the rapid jump cuts in the video. (5) The track remains consistent in volume and energy until the very end, concluding abruptly with the final visual frame.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and share a fun travel experience in Seoul, highlighting key tourist moments from arrival at the airport to visiting landmarks and enjoying the autumn scenery.
